Form group printing not default main

Settings.QueryText: SELECT Proformas.Ref AS Ref, Proformas.Date AS Date, BEGINOFPERIOD(Proformas.Date, DAY) AS AccountingDate, Proformas.Number AS Number, Proformas.Hotel AS Hotel, Proformas.Company AS Company, Proformas.AccountingCustomer AS AccountingCustomer, Proformas.AccountingContract AS AccountingContract, Proformas.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, Proformas.Sum AS Sum, CASE WHEN Proformas.Posted THEN ISNULL(Proformas.Sum, 0) - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) ELSE 0 END AS Payment, ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) AS Balance, Proformas.AccountingCurrency AS AccountingCurrency, Proformas.Remarks AS Remarks, Proformas.Author AS Author, CASE WHEN Proformas.Posted THEN CASE WHEN Proformas.CheckDate <> &qEmptyDate AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Proformas.CheckDate, DAY) < BEGINOFPERIOD(&qCurrentDate, DAY) AND ISNULL(Proformas.Sum, 0) = ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) THEN 6 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Proformas.Sum, 0) - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) >= Proformas.Sum THEN 5 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Proformas.Sum, 0) - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) > 0 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END END END ELSE 0 END AS IDStatus, Proformas.Posted AS Posted, Proformas.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, Proformas.CheckDate AS CheckDate FROM Document.ProformaInvoice AS Proformas LEFT JOIN AccumulationRegister.InvoiceAccounts.Balance(, ) AS InvoiceAccountsBalance ON Proformas.Ref = InvoiceAccountsBalance.Invoice WHERE CASE WHEN &qHotel <> VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef) THEN Proformas.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel) ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qGuestGroup = VALUE(Catalog.GuestGroups.EmptyRef) THEN TRUE WHEN &qGuestGroup <> VALUE(Catalog.GuestGroups.EmptyRef) AND Proformas.GuestGroup = &qGuestGroup THEN TRUE WHEN &qGuestGroup <> VALUE(Catalog.GuestGroups.EmptyRef) AND Proformas.Ref IN (SELECT DISTINCT ProformaInvoiceServices.Ref FROM Document.ProformaInvoice.Services AS ProformaInvoiceServices WHERE ProformaInvoiceServices.GuestGroup = &qGuestGroup) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
